## Completed chunk
Eight Lean4.21 core-only modules compose completed local bank words and bind the selected five-stage source's routing and chronological schedule.

Conditional-interface coverage: sequential_complete_bank composes whole local words with an endpoint universally quantified over arbitrary bank and remaining states, a common exact chart, and disjoint projectors summing to identity. It explicitly reconciles head-first physical execution with tail-first endpoint composition. Actual physical endpoints remain supplier premises.
Finite/source-binding coverage: the literal address-factor identity route(d*tau)N = route d(N*tau^-1), exact source stage/operand metadata and replica-major schedule, retaining all60 replicas. No complete Python instance enumeration or actual census is claimed checked.
Full-theorem coverage: no end-to-end multiplication, runtime or kappa theorem. Actual helper census, GL120/reduction/normalizer data, full-state forward/complemented-reverse words, across-replica partition, boundaries/restored selectors and costs remain open.

## Explicit author-checked kappa and pins
Base12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b; head005dd3f4e3cba8d1761abc4ab391aaf6d14d6f73.
Author-checked selected conditional kappa = 90446448750933/125000000000000000 = 0.000723571590007464.
This is source-matched construction context, not a bound derived by this package. Compiler, common-ancestor chart, restored-row, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-correctness and analytic-transfer conditions remain.
Literal bindings refer to research/five-stage-gen4-banks/bank_template.py, code/global_lowering.py and BANK-PROOF.md at the exact base.

## Reuse and comparison
Five supporting modules are reused unchanged: BankRouting, SplitProjectors, CoordinatePartitions, ExactFrameTransport and BankEndpoints. Three additions are SequentialCompleteBank and the two current five-stage address/schedule bindings. The composition invokes existing weighted-partition results; no novelty claim is made for generic group/partition algebra or routine list glue.
Compared with #236's older d1d6 paired-cube finite identities/arithmetic and #487's1320-port interface: this chunk supplies the current source-specific sequential completed-bank connection, without transferring their finite instances. The complete3606-module archive of #236 was not rechecked for an exhaustive theorem comparison.
The construction retains PR197/PR200 completed-bank attribution, Henry Grant/hcg890 PR234 lowering, eumemic's retained source527 work, Apache-2.0 and existing assistance disclosures.

## Reproduction and evidence
From research/lean-sequential-bank-bindings, run python3 check.py --lean /path/to/lean-4.21.0-linux/bin/lean --build-dir /tmp/sequential-bank-check.
Linux/Python3, fresh nonexistent output directory, offline, no Mathlib/download. Eight source hashes/imports are checked, hard per-module60s/4GiB and review45s/3.5GiB. No objects shipped.
Fresh isolated replay:12.1047compiler seconds,0.00368queue,peak VM2,266,423,296 bytes. All eight object hashes and77 complete axiom outputs match accepted evidence after explicit whitespace normalization. Independent review and both authors confirmed final scope/replay metadata.
Local kernel results are separate from exact-head fork CI, upstream CI and maintainer gates; those are not claimed passed. One20-file additive commit; no inherited root changes.

commits.messageBody: Eight core-only Lean modules; exact completed-word composition and current five-stage address/schedule bindings. Local isolated replay passed. Author-checked conditional project kappa=90446448750933/125000000000000000; physical suppliers and full theorem remain open.

The joint-dual check froze these three files by hash, but nothing in its
computation reads them. Any edit to them, even a README typo, therefore broke
`verify_joint_dual.py` until the manifest, `joint-dual-kappa.json` and
`joint-dual-validation.json` were regenerated.

Remove the three names from the pin script and from the closure check, re-pin,
and regenerate the two derived certificates. The conditional kappa and every
mathematical field are unchanged; the diff to the certificates is hashes only.
Update the current reproduction guide's "Shared source bindings" section.
Earlier round notes that describe the old binding are left as historical.
